description: Stock ticker lookup: find the ticker symbol for a company, fund, index or crypto by name, with exchange, type, sector and industry. Use before /stock/quote or /stock/history when you only have a company name, or to find a company's listings on several exchanges. Example: q=volvo. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
